privacy.title: Data Security & Privacy
privacy.l1: Storage: core data such as transactions, accounts, and categories is stored in your local or self-hosted database by default, and is not uploaded automatically by LedgerFlow.
privacy.l2: Encrypted transport: use HTTPS for AI requests whenever possible; the API key is used only for requests to your configured provider.
privacy.l3: Minimal context: only necessary context is sent when you trigger AI features, avoiding redundant data exposure.
privacy.l4: Privacy protection: review and remove sensitive notes before export/sharing.

privacy.title: Privacy & Security Strategy
privacy.l1: Ledger data is stored in your local or self-hosted database by default.
